name: platform-spine-m1-20260717
goal: Create the additive HaloFire platform spine for shared Job, Customer, Site, Employee, Document, AuditEvent, ReviewItem, and ModuleRegistry records without modifying halofire_bids.db in place or rewriting AutoBid private tables.
exit_criteria: typed platform-core schemas define all shared records and reject malformed identities
an additive reversible SQLite migration creates only platform_* tables on an explicit copy with a source digest receipt
AutoBid-private tables remain unchanged and the source corpus is never opened writable
the migration emits source-to-spine link records only for source-backed natural keys and never fabricates company data
verification_gates: source corpus SHA and schema snapshot are recorded before migration
migration rejects in-place target and source/target digest mismatch
up and down migrations are exercised on a disposable copy
platform package typecheck/build, focused migration test, loop guard, rulebook, and brain postflight pass
